items.label: Heavy-Duty & Reliable
items.value: Includes two furniture dollies and each pare with a 800-pound static load capacity and a 700-pound dynamic load capacity, these dollies are designed to effortlessly move heavy furniture, appliances, and other weighty items

items.label: Adjustable & Compact
items.value: Easily adjust this dolly to 3 lengths (16.5", 18.9", and 21.06") to accommodate a variety of objects and furniture. Its compact design ensures easy storage, freeing up valuable floor space. Use two sets for moving larger items with ease

items.label: Smooth Movement & Enhanced Protection
items.value: Equipped with four ball-bearing swivel casters, this dolly glides smoothly in any direction, and the wheels with brakes can also be fixed. The hardwood and metal are seamlessly integrated, and carpeted ends provide an extra layer of protection

items.label: Versatile Application
items.value: This moving dolly can be used to transport a wide range of furniture and appliances, including beds, sofas, tables, closets, refrigerators, washing machines, and more. It is suitable for use on various floor types, such as hardwood floors, tile floors, and low-pile carpets

items.label: Easy Assembly & After-Sales Service
items.value: Includes a detailed instruction manual and all necessary tools for quick and easy assembly. We offer professional customer support and efficient replacement services for any quality issues you may encounter
